Review of 'Evil Dead Burn' film highlights gore over scares

The Hollywood horror film 'Evil Dead Burn' has been released in Indian cinemas. Reviews suggest the first half of the film is frightening, but the latter half falters, with critics noting an overreliance on gore at the expense of genuine scares. The film's approach to horror is being questioned.
